## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; mixed signals with Energy the lone positive sector and widespread weakness elsewhere. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 = 4/5 Technology), and major large-cap divergences (AAPL ABOVE TREND vs MSFT BELOW TREND; NVDA CORRECTION) confirm a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.07%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND; sector-level breadth positive while most others are negative. Technology shows strong individual leaders but sector return is slightly negative (Tech: 1W -0.11%), so leadership is concentrated in a few names rather than broad strength.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Healthcare is weakest: AMGN (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.51% | 1M: -22.44%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Communication also lag materially on the week; internal weakness is broad across cyclical and defensive pockets.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SBUX (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -6.44%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.12% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -7.04%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -10.76% | 1M: -17.04%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and Consumer Discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence as several large caps show opposite 1W vs 1M signs — this is a MAJOR divergence, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed and concentrated: META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -2.07%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION; Tech breadth is not broad despite headline winners.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed/soft: C (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND sits alongside JPM (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.34%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -2.96% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION — sector showing internal rotation rather than clear leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Weak and under pressure: AMGN (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.51% | 1M: -22.44%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.22% | 1M: +3.03%) CORRECTION; sector breadth: meaningful weakness, defensive names not leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain a neutral stance: favor selective Energy and top Tech names (VLO ABOVE TREND, INTC ABOVE TREND, AMD ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Healthcare and fallen Consumer Discretionary names (AMGN BELOW TREND, SBUX BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; exercise caution given narrow technology concentration and MAJOR divergence across large caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: AMGN (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -6.44%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.38% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (VLO ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND) — only sector in clear weekly positive. BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary (broad weekly declines); Tech needs to prove breadth beyond a few leaders. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION — a sustained weekly reclaim above the recent monthly high would signal end of correction. AAPL (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +7.10%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold recent support would warn of broader tech pullback. INTC (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND — continuation above this week’s high would confirm momentum-driven leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (+65): ORCL (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — bullish news corroborates price strength (confirmed). QCOM (+65): QCOM (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +9.32%) ABOVE TREND — news and price both confirming. AMAT (+55): AMAT (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -13.53%) RECOVERY — positive headlines but 1M weakness signals partial divergence and a tactical setup.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NFLX (-50): NFLX (1W: -8.12% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines align with sharp weekly weakness (confirmed). AMZN (-45): AMZN (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -7.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative. TSLA (-55): TSLA (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +9.24%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price remains strong (divergence to monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC ABOVE TREND, AMD ABOVE TREND and META ABOVE TREND are showing the most relative strength while Energy (VLO, XOM) is the only broadly positive sector. Key risk is MAJOR divergence among large caps and narrow technology leadership, with several sentiment-driven mismatches (e.g., bullish ORCL/QCOM vs weak sector breadth) to monitor.
